question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hazard
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hazard"** means a danger or risk. (खतरा)

 
 
• **Example:** The slippery roads pose a **hazard **to drivers.
 
 
 
• **"Accident"** refers to an unexpected event, typically one resulting in damage or injury. (दुर्घटना)
 
 
• **Example:** The **accident** on the highway caused a major traffic jam.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Hazard'** is **'Accident'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Accident**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Marvel** (चमत्कार): Something that causes wonder or astonishment.

 
 
• **Example:** The Grand Canyon is a natural **marvel.**
 
 
 
• **Miracle** (अद्भुत घटना): An extraordinary event that is not explicable by natural or scientific laws.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a **miracle** that everyone survived the crash.
 
 
 
• **Ardent** (उत्साही): Very enthusiastic or passionate.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an **ardent** supporter of the local football team.
